name: ROE
source:
Welcome to ROE, a visual novel where you play as a 13 year old girl who starts to notice weird things around her.  Follow her through what seems to be a normal school day and witness things that only she seems to see.

Things aren't what they appear to be. 

Trust no one.

[From [url=https://not-anna.itch.io/roe]Itch.io[/url]]
